notes: Pass B web search run for all 22 hospitals (38 of 40 web calls used); pass A fetch was blocked (jobs.chsbuffalo.org robots) or uninformative (careers.rochesterregional.org has no keyword URL). Upstate now uses a new board at careers.upstate.edu/jobs/<slug> (PageUp URLs are dead); Kaleida and Rochester Regional postings were captured via DirectEmployers mirrors because their own boards (Infor / aplitrak) expose no stable public URLs. Zero pediatric APP postings found (via search only, low confidence) for Millard Fillmore, Olean, ECMC, Adirondack, Auburn, Medina, Niagara Falls Memorial, Oneida, Oswego, Rome and Ellis; a Niagara Falls 'Nurse Practitioner PEDS' recruiter listing was a private pediatric office, not NFMMC, and was excluded. The Upstate 'Golisano BERT Coordinator APP' posting (careers.upstate.edu/jobs/golisano-bert-coordinator-app-syracuse-new-york-united-states) returned an empty page twice and was not captured. WebFetch paraphrases descriptions rather than quoting verbatim; every description field is flagged in raw_notes. Operator dropped 1 candidate(s) before merge (2023-dated or duplicate aggregator copy).

url_fixes.why: The PageUp URLs (/cw/en-us/...) 404. Upstate now posts on a Phenom-style board at https://careers.upstate.edu/jobs/<slug>; web search surfaced live postings there (job IDs 74577, 88974). Keyword query pattern is a guess; postings are at /jobs/<title-slug>-syracuse-new-york-united-states.

/search/jobs.json?q= returns 404 and WebFetch of jobs.chsbuffalo.org is blocked by robots.txt. A site-restricted web search shows a category page 'Advanced Practitioners Careers' at /search/advanced-practitioners/jobs plus posting URLs like /jobs/7399629-nurse-practitioner-school-health-program-harvey-austin-sch. Engine may need a non-JSON HTML parse or a different fetch UA.

nlh.org/careers has no parseable listings; postings are WordPress posts (nlh.org/?p=NNNNN) tagged 'provider' / 'fnp'. The job-tag archive lists provider openings including the pediatric/family NP.

mvhealthsystem.org/careers is 404. A search hit for an MVHS Pediatric Hospitalist physician job lives on social.icims.com (job 41270939), so MVHS uses iCIMS; the tenant board (likely careers-mvhs.icims.com or similar) was not confirmed within budget. Use this URL as the lead to identify the iCIMS tenant.
